title: Wizard Contest Modpack
description: Pick a magical class and explore rich landscapes! Have fun with friends!
body:
## **A wizard is just as good as their knowledge and craft.**

Discover the world through one of 11 magical classes of varying difficulty. 
Play with friends of different classes or in Single Player. This modpack has a big variety of mods besides the essential magic ones to enhance the immersion. What i got you are medieval themed mods, decoration mods, a few cooking mods with a cozy feel, overhauled structures, more places to use a brush on, vibrant biomes, a few more dungeons and lots of ambience mods to account for many different playstyles while still feeling mostly grounded.

Don't fret, though, if you feel stuck on one class. You can request a class change on a server, as well as use some things of the other magic professions.

### Who said that you can't dabble in other arts?
You might not be as knowledgable as the trained caster, but with ingenuity you can grasp a bit more power here and there.



### This pack features:
- Magical classes!
- Beautiful landscapes!
- Cozy decorations!
- Tea!
- Waystones!
- More archeology!
- Sophisticated storage solutions for sophisticated people!
- Camping equipment like sleeping bags or marshmallows on sticks!
- Xaero's World Map so you don't get lost!
- A ton of overhauled and additional structures!
- A corpse mod, so you don't lose your stuff as easily!
- Lootr so noone is left out when it comes to treasure!
- Expanded Nether and End. Time for a new challenge!
- Peaceful depletion for the peaceful players that want the hunger mechanic!
- Fabulous foods, from wine to a candlelight dinner, from mint ice cream to strawberries and adzuki beans. Eat your heart out!
- Soothing rain sounds for the hot cocoa evenings and creepy cave sounds for the daring spellslingers!


### Upcoming: 
- A duel mechanic for multiplayer with special rewards!
- Updated class rules!
- More Balancing!

Class Selection mod by Void_Purr
